preconditions.description: The number of registration requests n must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(name) <= 32 for name in names)
preconditions.description: Each name in the input must be between 1 and 32 characters long.
All characters in each name must be lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: If a name is not already in the database, the output must be 'OK'.

The output name must not exceed 32 characters.

repair_issue.instruction: Replace the expression to correctly handle the generation of new names with the smallest unused number.
repair_issue.task_evidence: If a name is already in the database, the system makes up a new user name, sends it to the user as a prompt and also inserts the prompt into the database. The new name is formed by the following rule. Numbers, starting with 1, are appended one after another to name (name1, name2, ...), among these numbers the least i is found so that namei does not yet exist in the database.
